description: Search Dukes County GIS open geospatial datasets (parcels, addresses, zoning & public works) by keyword. Returns each dataset's name, summary, record_count, owner/org, and its Feature Service `url`, pass that url to query_layer / layer_info. For a record count (optionally by a field such as city) use arcgis_dukescounty_count_records, which finds the layer by name.

org_id.description: Optional ArcGIS orgId to override the default (Dukes County GIS).

name: arcgis_dukescounty_search_datasets
title: Arcgis Dukescounty Search Datasets
